items.t: GRI dates: UPS effective Dec 21, FedEx Jan 4, 2027
items.body: FedEx announced its latest GRI on Sept 18, 2026, effective Jan 4, 2027. The prior two were announced Sept 12, 2025 (effective Jan 5, 2026) and Sept 13, 2024 (effective Jan 6, 2025). UPS announced on Oct 23, 2026, effective Dec 21, 2026, against an Oct 31, 2025 announcement for Dec 22, 2025 and an Oct 21, 2022 announcement for Dec 27, 2022.

items.t: Average increase is 5.9% again at both UPS and FedEx
items.body: FedEx's 5.9% average for Jan 4, 2027 is described as its fourth straight 5.9% headline, after 6.9% in the GRI labeled 2023 and 4.9% in the 2018 through 2021 GRIs. UPS's 5.9% average net for Dec 21, 2026 matches its GRIs labeled 2024 through 2026, after 6.9% in the 2023 GRI and 4.9% in 2018 through 2021. UPS Small Business Rates rise 4.5% on Dec 21, 2026, with a new 5% fuel surcharge on all SBR shipments.

items.t: 2026 peak add-ons run above 2025 and 2024 levels
items.body: FedEx's Nov 23 - Dec 27, 2026 window (announced July 22, 2026) sets Ground residential at $0.80 against $0.65 in 2025, Additional Handling at $11.85 against $10.90, and Oversize at $117.25 against $108.50. Ground Economy is $4.05 against $3.55 in 2025, and residential demand was $0.30 to $0.55 in 2024. UPS's 2026 Large Package peak of $117.50 compares with $107 in 2025 and $99 in 2024, and Over Maximum Limits is $590 against $540 and $495.

items.t: Fuel surcharges near 29%, against a 20% record in 2025
items.body: On Oct 26, 2026, company tables at $6.28 diesel put UPS's fuel surcharge at 29.5% and FedEx's at 29%. In 2025, UPS and FedEx Ground both reached a record 20% on June 23, and the earlier peak was FedEx at 19.50% in mid-2022. UPS changed domestic tables on Jan 5, Mar 9 (its third increase of 2026) and Aug 10, and the table effective Nov 2, 2026 adds 0.50 point at the same diesel price.

items.t: USPS 2026 mid-year changes and a new fuel surcharge
items.body: USPS announced on Mar 25, 2026 a temporary 8% increase effective Apr 26, 2026 through Jan 17, 2027. It announced on May 11, 2026 a July 12, 2026 change that removed Ground Advantage Commercial ounce tiers (avg +11.8%). The mid-year changes in 2024 (July 14, Parcel Select +25%) and 2025 (July 13, Priority Mail +6.3%, Ground Advantage +7.1%) were single July changes. On Oct 26, 2026 USPS announced a weekly fuel surcharge for January 2027, whereas a 2021 USPS note said it had no fuel surcharge.

items.t: New in 2026: cubic triggers, USPS DIM cut, origin-ZIP charge
items.body: FedEx added cubic-volume triggers to Additional Handling and Oversize on Jan 12, 2026, and UPS adopted matching thresholds (10,368 and 17,280 cu in) on Jan 26, 2026 after postponing from Aug 17, 2025. USPS cut its DIM divisor from 166 to 139 on July 12, 2026 and rounds dimensions up to whole inches; its previous divisor cut, in 2019, went from 194 to 166. UPS announced Oct 23, 2026 an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers, effective Dec 21, 2026 or later, with the amount not stated.
